trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and it's healthy again. But the SEV2 incident got opened twice, so on-call was probably paged twice.

**Rollback:**
- All three regions (us-east, us-west and eu-west) were on v2.3.1, failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- v2.3.0 is the most recent healthy release. The builds after it, v2.3.1-rc and v2.3.1, were both unhealthy. The release history isn't listed in order, so I went by sequence number.
- All three regions now run v2.3.0, health checks pass and the error rate is about 0.2%. No approval was needed because v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.

**Incident:**
- My first request to open the SEV2 timed out. I checked the incident list, it showed nothing, so I sent the request again and got back INC-0002.
- Checking the list again showed INC-0001 too. The first request had gone through after all, just too late to appear when I checked.
- Both incidents have the same text. They say what broke, that I rolled back to v2.3.0, that the service has recovered, and that the cause of the v2.3.1 problem still needs to be found.

**What you need to do:** I can't close incidents with the tools I have. Please close INC-0002 as a duplicate of INC-0001 and tell on-call that the second page is the same issue.

v2.3.1 shouldn't be redeployed until its fault is found. v2.3.1-rc had the same problem.
